001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.abilities.ai;
002
003import org.lwjgl.util.vector.Vector2f;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.ai.FleetAIFlags;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.rules.MemoryAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.characters.AbilityPlugin;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.abilities.GoDarkAbility;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.events.BaseEventPlugin.MarketFilter;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Abilities;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.MemFlags;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.misc.SupportFleetIntel;
016import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.IntervalUtil;
017import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
018
019public class GoDarkAbilityAI extends BaseAbilityAI {
020
021        private IntervalUtil interval = new IntervalUtil(0.05f, 0.15f);
022
023//      public GoDarkAbilityAI(AbilityPlugin ability, ModularFleetAIAPI ai) {
024//              super(ability, ai);
025//      }
026
027        public void advance(float days) {
028                interval.advance(days * EmergencyBurnAbilityAI.AI_FREQUENCY_MULT);
029                if (!interval.intervalElapsed()) return;
030                
031                
032                MemoryAPI mem = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
033                
034                
035                if (ability.isActiveOrInProgress()) {
036                        mem.set(FleetAIFlags.HAS_SPEED_PENALTY, true, 0.2f);
037                        mem.set(FleetAIFlags.HAS_LOWER_DETECTABILITY, true, 0.2f);
038                }
039                
040                boolean playerSupportFleet = Misc.isPlayerSupportFleet(fleet) && 
041                                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(SupportFleetIntel.SUPPORT_FLEET_FOLLOW);
042                if (playerSupportFleet && fleet.isInCurrentLocation()) {
043                        CampaignFleetAPI player = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
044                        //float dist = Misc.getDistance(player, fleet);
045                        AbilityPlugin sb = player.getAbility(Abilities.GO_DARK);
046                        if (sb != null) {
047                                if (sb.isActive()) {
048                                        if (!ability.isActive()) ability.activate();
049                                } else if (!sb.isActive()) {
050                                        if (ability.isActive()) ability.deactivate();
051                                }
052                        }
053                        return;
054                }
055                
056                CampaignFleetAPI pursueTarget = mem.getFleet(FleetAIFlags.PURSUIT_TARGET);
057                CampaignFleetAPI fleeingFrom = mem.getFleet(FleetAIFlags.NEAREST_FLEEING_FROM);
058                Vector2f travelDest = mem.getVector2f(FleetAIFlags.TRAVEL_DEST);
059                boolean wantsTransponderOn = mem.getBoolean(FleetAIFlags.WANTS_TRANSPONDER_ON);
060                
061//              if (pursueTarget != null && pursueTarget.isPlayerFleet() && fleeingFrom != null) {
062//                      System.out.println("dfsdfwefwe");
063//              }
064                
065                // if being pursued
066                if (fleeingFrom != null) {
067                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(fleet.getLocation(), fleeingFrom.getLocation()) - fleet.getRadius() - fleeingFrom.getRadius();
068                        if (dist < 0) return;
069                        float detRange = fleeingFrom.getMaxSensorRangeToDetect(fleet);
070                        float ourSpeed = fleet.getFleetData().getBurnLevel();
071                        float theirSpeed = fleeingFrom.getFleetData().getBurnLevel();
072                        // slower than closest pursuer, but could hide using go dark: do it
073                        if (!ability.isActiveOrInProgress()) {
074                                if (dist > detRange * GoDarkAbility.DETECTABILITY_MULT + 100f && ourSpeed < theirSpeed &&
075                                                dist > detRange && dist < detRange + 300f) {
076                                        ability.activate();
077                                }
078                        } else { // already seen by them, or faster than them with "go dark" off
079                                //if (dist < detRange || ourSpeed / GoDarkAbility.MAX_BURN_MULT  > theirSpeed) {
080                                // since going dark means "slow moving", ourSpeed doesn't actually include that, so it's still
081                                // as if go dark was turned off
082                                if (dist < detRange || ourSpeed > theirSpeed) {
083                                        ability.deactivate();
084                                }
085                        }
086                        return;
087                }
088                
089                // if wants to use transponder & not being pursued, don't do it
090                //if (wantsTransponderOn) {
091                if (fleet.isTransponderOn()) {
092                        return;
093                }
094                
095//              if (pursueTarget != null && pursueTarget.isPlayerFleet()) {
096//                      System.out.println("dfsdfwefwe");
097//              }
098                
099                // if ok with using it, and not being pursued
100                // if pursuing, target can't see us, and we're gaining: leave on
101                // if pursuing, target can see us or we're losing groung: turn off
102                if (pursueTarget != null) {
103                        float closingSpeed = Misc.getClosingSpeed(fleet.getLocation(), pursueTarget.getLocation(), 
104                                                                                                          fleet.getVelocity(),pursueTarget.getVelocity());
105                        if (closingSpeed <= 1 && ability.isActiveOrInProgress()) {
106                                ability.deactivate();
107                        }
108                        return;
109                }
110                
111                // is the destination nearby? turn on
112                boolean smuggler = mem.getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_SMUGGLER);
113                boolean pirate = mem.getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PIRATE);
114                // don't use for general pirates; too grief-y
115                pirate = false;
116                
117                boolean nearestMarketHostile = false;
118                MarketAPI nearestMarket = Misc.findNearestLocalMarket(fleet, 2000, new MarketFilter() {
119                        public boolean acceptMarket(MarketAPI market) {
120                                return true;
121                        }
122                });
123                if (nearestMarket != null && nearestMarket.getFaction().isHostileTo(fleet.getFaction())) {
124                        nearestMarketHostile = true;
125                }
126                
127                if ((smuggler || pirate || nearestMarketHostile) && !ability.isActiveOrInProgress() && travelDest != null) {
128                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(fleet.getLocation(), travelDest);
129                        if (dist < 1500) {
130                                ability.activate();
131                        }
132                        return;
133                }
134        }
135}
